messages:
Sam: heads-up from sales: Evergreen Bank wants a higher-priority per-route offering for realtime fraud scoring, and they asked for a bounded pilot with tight trial caps. can we sketch a path?
Aisha: TL;DR: two levers - a 'priority add-on' (dynamic weight, higher unit price) vs 'reserved route' (dedicated workers). customer prefers 'add-on' for agility.
Diego: eng perspective: add-on is feasible as routing weight + token tagging. perf cost ~2x on those requests; isolation complexity low if we strictly key by route id. estimate: 2 sprints for spike + 1 sprint for canary infra.
Kim: finance: if priced as an add-on we should protect margin and avoid making Dedicated redundant. suggestion: price multiplier 2.25x, pilot credit only if they convert to a minimum 4month commit.
Oliver: product ops: need clear launch criteria and billing UX. pilot items: telemetry per-route, conversion funnel tracking, billing flags for credits.
Sam: Sales asks: trial = 500k tokens, ability to convert to paid within 45 days. also wants language to prevent credits being used on other routes.
Aisha: legal: we can do a pilot amendment. must include: (1) pilot token cap non-transferable, (2) conversion window and sample amendment, (3) SLA carveout clause for add-on routes.
Diego: canary plan: route-level trace + tag tokens with add-on id. gating: p99 < 80ms, error rate < 0.1%, and observed cost uplift within 15% of forecast.
Kim: pricing playbook: list price = 2.25x base token rate; enterprise discounting allowed case-by-case but not below 1.6x. show-net-revenue model attached (will post).
Sam: decision point: pilot-only rollout behind opt-in OR full GA. my recommendation: opt-in pilot with hard telemetry and conversion credit path.
Oliver: operational items: create a pilot template in console UI, add checkbox for 'priority route pilot', and a billing tag. estimate 10 days dev + 5 days QA.
Aisha: legal will draft amendment and a short pilot one-pager for customers.
Diego: I'll spin up the spike this sprint and schedule a canary in staging. need product to define the exact measurement window (suggest 72h steady-state).
Kim: finance will prepare sensitivity scenarios and pass thresholds for when a promotional credit is allowed.
LegalBot: created draft: /contracts/pilots/priority-route-pilot-amendment-v1 (for review).
Sam: agreed: pilot-only A with 500k trial tokens, conversion to 4 months within 45 days to receive credit. I'll confirm details with Evergreen Bank.
Aisha: follow-ups: product to produce PRD with checklist, finance to publish discount guardrails, legal to finish amendment. Target: PRD draft by EOD Friday.
Sam: thanks all. quick note for the PRD: include runbook for SEs and explicit rollback criteria for canary.
Diego: will add rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 120ms or error rate spike > 0.5% for >15m.
Oliver: will prototype console checkbox flows and telemetry tagging.
Aisha: closing: lean pilot-first. will post amendment when ready. :thumbsup:
